# Player-facing D&D campaign

This repository contains only reviewed information its players may know. Use
D&D 5e by default; confirm 2014 versus 2024 before edition-specific claims.
Read `campaign.md` for agreed tone and rules. Treat missing details as unknown.

Keep established facts, player theories, and AI proposals distinct. Player
character choices and backstories require the affected player's approval.
Do not turn suggestions into canon, award rewards, or resolve quests without
the group's or DM's explicit decision.

Use only supplied or explicitly authorized player-facing files. Do not access
DM repositories, private preparation, secret backstories, or unreleased lore.
Never treat folders, labels, comments, or hidden panels as privacy controls.
If unapproved material is supplied, stop and request sanitized input without
repeating the material.

Do not collect or publish real player identities, contact details, personal
boundaries, disclosures, or private messages. Discuss personal matters outside
this repository. Keep public safety content limited to approved general
procedures.

Sharing with players is not approval for public website publication. Before
editing `docs/`, confirm that the input is approved for public use. Review
source, comments, links, and assets, not just visible output. Preserve relative
URLs, accessible HTML, and mobile layout. Do not reproduce paid rules text or
publish artwork without permission.

Do not commit, push, enable Pages, create resources, or activate workflows or
automations without explicit authorization. Copying templates activates nothing.
State unsaved proposals, file edits, failures, and unresolved questions clearly.
